headline: HIS Specialist | EHR Workflow Design, Configuration, Testing and Go-Live | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR company, where I took close to 200 client practices from discovery to go-live. I ran current-state and future-state workflow reviews with clinicians, configured practice-specific workflows, tested them, trained 200+ end users and supported go-live and stabilization. Before that I worked in emergency medicine and a COVID ICU, so I know the inpatient and acute workflows a new hospital information system has to support. My work so far has been ambulatory and vendor-side, not a hospital-wide HIS rollout.
greenway_bullets: Ran EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices: discovery, current-state and future-state workflow documentation, practice-specific configuration, testing and go-live support.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, and built training content from the validated workflows.
Turned recurring client pain points into requirements and feature requests with product and engineering teams; many shipped to clients with positive feedback.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety Committee, Functional Advisory Committee and Clinical Content Team.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: provider personas, workflow mapping across the visit, and React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented and demonstrated workflows to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: workflow assessment and redesign, requirements and use cases, configuration, test scripts and testing, go-live readiness and stabilization
end-user training, training content, stakeholder demos, issue logs and status updates, clinician engagement
emergency, ICU and ambulatory workflows; patient safety review; Microsoft Office; AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), React, GitHub
thesis_html: A new HIS works when the build matches how clinicians actually work on the floor.
why_fit: Current and future-state reviews, configuration and testing for each practice.
Training content, demos and support through stabilization.
Senior resident in a Level 1 trauma ED and registrar in a COVID ICU.
